en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed "Invalid effort level" errors when a routine resumes a session, or a session starts with no set effort, in orgs where an admin caps a model's effort
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了在管理员限制了某模型 effort 的组织中，例程恢复 session 或 session 启动时未设置 effort 会报 "Invalid effort level" 错误的问题
